material.acceptance_criteria: An uncaught client error and a failed start are POSTed to the relay endpoint and appear as a client-error line in the server log within one second, subject to the existing rate limit.
material.description: rust/crates/web/site/main.js:241-244 handles a failed start by setting document.body.dataset.error and calling console.error only. Nothing posts to the client-error relay (rust/crates/server/src/relay.rs:29 serve_client_error), so client errors never reach the server log.
material.resolution: Client errors POST to /client-error from the page catch path; oscraftd serves the page at /site/ with a traversal guard, and the browser CI job checks the page renders from oscraftd and that one client error reaches the server log. Intermediate commits a030152 and 73b9583 reverted and failed to restore the mod-lsp Lua job; e65fec0 restores it, so the final diff is only these hunks.
material.subject: Browser client never reports its errors to the server relay
material.witness: ci-status run 38895162049 for e65fec03c43d37bb3b729d3f1076383c5e538a9a; static_files.rs resolve() rejects non-Normal components; main.js POST matches lib.rs route
material.witness_plan: CI step loads the client in a headless browser, forces a throw, and asserts the server log contains a client-error line with the session and message.
